newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH ENTREPRENEUR BUYS FLEMISH AIRLINE VLM.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH ENTREPRENEUR BUYS FLEMISH AIRLINE VLM.

text.p: Dutch venture capitalist Jaap Rosen Jacobson said on Tuesday he had bought the majority of shares in Flemish airline VLM, but his spokesman added this did not affect his plans to relaunch bankrupt planemaker Fokker.
"He has bought the largest part of the shares in VLM," the spokesman said, confirming a report in Belgian financial newspaper De Financiele Tijd.
"But this takeover has nothing to do with Fokker. His plans to relaunch Fokker have not been changed," the spokesman said.
The managing director at VLM would keep his job, he said, adding that Jacobson only acted as an investor.
VLM has five Fokker 50 aircraft which it uses for services from Antwerp and Duesseldorf to London City Airport, Rotterdam and Nice.
